# Change log {.unnumbered}

Each version of the book is archived on Zenodo with its own DOI (see "How to cite" in
the [README](https://github.com/esantos2ua/EcologicalAnalysesInJulia#readme)). Version
numbers follow semantic versioning: a change in the first number means a major
reorganization, in the second, new content, and in the third, corrections.

## v1.0.0 (2026-10-03) {.unnumbered}

First citable version.

- Chapters 1 to 11, in English and Portuguese: introduction, from question to model
  (plan only), prerequisites, Julia basics, data wrangling, visualization, exploratory
  data analysis, linear models, GLMs, functions, and resampling and simulation.
- Exercises with automatic checking (`check`).
- PDFs of both editions.
